english:
Loads 2 bullets at a time.

Precision Hits grant 1 stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike grants the following benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 1|2|3|4|5 Ammo Loaded
• 6%|7%|8%|9%|10% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 3.4%|6.8%|10.2%|13.6%|17% increased damage against Combatants

Stacks persist through stow.

source.text:
Craftable Kinetic Aggressive Scout Rifle
Loads 2 bullets at a time

Precision Hits grant a stack of Cranial Spike for 4.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Stacks persist through stow.

Cranial Spike x1 | +8 Range, +2 Stability, 0.94x Reload Duration Multiplier, +4 Aim Assist, +1 Ammo Loaded, and 3.4% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x2 | +16 Range, +4 Stability, 0.93x Reload Duration Multiplier, +8 Aim Assist, +2 Ammo Loaded, and 6.8% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x3 | +24 Range, +6 Stability, 0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier, +12 Aim Assist, +3 Ammo Loaded, and 10.2% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x4 | +32 Range, +8 Stability, 0.91x Reload Duration Multiplier, +16 Aim Assist, +4 Ammo Loaded, and 13.6% increased damage against Combatants.
Cranial Spike x5 | +40 Range, +10 Stability, 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier, +20 Aim Assist, +5 Ammo Loaded, and 17% increased damage against Combatants.

↑Dark-Forged Trigger:
Passively grants 0.92x Hipfire Refire Delay, -50% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size, and -?x Hipfire Accuracy Cone Growth. 
Prefers Crits over Bodyshots if Precision AA Cone overlaps.
24% [15%] increased Hipfire Damage while at x5 Cranial Spike.
Adds up to a 45% Damage Buff against Combatants while Hipfiring.
